entryPolicy: One entry per named enchantment; categories, rarity, Wiki section, implementation and seasonal status retain the source distinctions.

description.en: Attacks on mobs that are not actively targeting you deal increased damage.
description.zh-Hant: 攻擊尚未主動鎖定你的怪物時會造成額外傷害。

description.en: Each soul you absorb grants a small amount of health.
description.zh-Hant: 吸收靈魂時會恢復少量生命值。

description.en: Whenever you use an artifact, your next attack deals bonus damage.
description.zh-Hant: 使用神器後，下一次攻擊會造成額外傷害。

description.en: Chance to summon a bee after defeating a mob, with up to 3 bees joining your side.
description.zh-Hant: 擊敗怪物後有機率召喚蜜蜂，最多可有 3 隻蜜蜂加入你的一方。

description.en: Has a 30% chance to chain a cluster of mobs together and keep them bound for a short time.
description.zh-Hant: 有 30% 機率將一群怪物束縛並鎖在一起一小段時間。

description.en: Deal increased damage against already wounded enemies.
description.zh-Hant: 對已受傷的敵人造成額外傷害。

description.en: Adds damage to the next attack after rolling.
description.zh-Hant: 翻滾後，下一次攻擊會增加傷害。

description.en: Some of your attacks can be followed up by another attack in quick succession.
description.zh-Hant: 部分攻擊可在短時間內接續發動一次。

description.en: Gives a chance to deal triple damage based on the number of souls you have.
description.zh-Hant: 依你持有的靈魂數量，有機率造成三倍傷害。

description.en: Sets mobs on fire for three seconds, dealing damage over time.
description.zh-Hant: 使怪物著火 3 秒並造成持續傷害。

description.en: Slows mobs after hit for three seconds.
description.zh-Hant: 命中後使怪物減速 3 秒。

description.en: This effect pulls mobs in range toward's the weapon's impact point.
description.zh-Hant: 將範圍內的怪物拉向武器命中位置。

description.en: When you defeat a mob, you are given a temporary shield that reduces damage by 50%.
description.zh-Hant: 擊敗怪物後會獲得暫時護盾，受到的傷害降低 50%。

description.en: Attacks deal extra damage to Illagers.
description.zh-Hant: 對災厄村民造成額外傷害。

description.en: Defeating a mob heals you a small portion of the mob's max health.
description.zh-Hant: 擊敗怪物時，依其最大生命值恢復少量生命。

description.en: Increases the chance for mobs to drop consumables.
description.zh-Hant: 提高怪物掉落消耗品的機率。

description.en: Attacking drains your life to grant one stack of Pain Cycle. At 5 stacks, your pain is channeled into your next attack.
description.zh-Hant: 攻擊會消耗生命並取得一層痛苦循環；累積 5 層後，痛苦會灌注至下一次攻擊。

description.en: Has a 30% chance to summon a poison cloud that deals damage to enemies in an area for three seconds.
description.zh-Hant: 有 30% 機率召喚毒雲，對範圍內敵人造成 3 秒傷害。

description.en: Enemies you defeat have a higher chance of dropping emeralds.
description.zh-Hant: 擊敗敵人時更容易掉落綠寶石。

value.zh-Hant: 近戰武器、遠程武器、盔甲

description.en: Has a 20% chance to spawn a circular area that heals you and all allies within the area.
description.zh-Hant: 有 20% 機率生成圓形治療區域，恢復你與隊友的生命。

value.zh-Hant: 遠程武器稱為 Radiance Shot

description.en: After defeating a mob, there is a 10% chance to increase your attack speed by +50% for a short time.
description.zh-Hant: 擊敗怪物後有 10% 機率短暫提高 50% 攻擊速度。

description.en: Makes your weapon sharper, causing it to deal more damage.
description.zh-Hant: 使武器更鋒利，造成更多傷害。

description.en: Increases damage against the Undead.
description.zh-Hant: 對亡靈造成額外傷害。

description.en: When you hit an enemy, gain a 20% chance to grant you a bunch of extra souls.
description.zh-Hant: 命中敵人時有 20% 機率獲得額外靈魂。

description.en: Chance to temporarily stun enemies.
description.zh-Hant: 有機率暫時擊暈敵人。

description.en: Has a 30% chance to summon a lightning strike that damages nearby enemies.
description.zh-Hant: 有 30% 機率召喚閃電，傷害附近敵人。

description.en: Deal more damage to enchanted enemies.
description.zh-Hant: 對附魔敵人造成更多傷害。

description.en: Your attacks decrease the attack damage of all nearby enemies for five seconds.
description.zh-Hant: 你的攻擊會使附近敵人的攻擊傷害降低 5 秒。

description.en: Gives you a chance to inflict critical hits dealing triple damage.
description.zh-Hant: 有機率造成三倍傷害的暴擊。

description.en: Mobs explode after they are defeated.
description.zh-Hant: 怪物被擊敗後會爆炸。

description.en: Defeating a mob reduces your health potion's cooldown time, allowing you to heal again more quickly.
description.zh-Hant: 擊敗怪物會縮短生命藥水冷卻時間，讓你更快恢復生命。

description.en: The last attack in a combo launches a shockwave, damaging enemies.
description.zh-Hant: 連擊最後一擊會釋放衝擊波，傷害敵人。

description.en: The last attack in a combo performs a swirling attack, damaging nearby enemies.
description.zh-Hant: 連擊最後一擊會旋轉攻擊，傷害附近敵人。

description.en: Attacking a target applies a damage multiplier that rises steadily to a max level, then is removed
description.zh-Hant: 攻擊目標會施加逐漸提升的傷害倍率，達到上限後移除。

value.en: Void Shot on some built-in ranged equipment
value.zh-Hant: 部分固有遠程武器上稱為 Void Shot

description.en: Increases attack speed for each consecutive shot. Resets one second after the attack.
description.zh-Hant: 連續射擊會提高攻擊速度；停止攻擊 1 秒後重置。

description.en: Whenever you use an artifact, your next few attacks become charged.
description.zh-Hant: 使用神器後，接下來數次攻擊會獲得蓄力。

description.en: Firing a shot also fires a second shot at a nearby enemy. The second shot has reduced damage.
description.zh-Hant: 射擊時還會向附近敵人發射第二支傷害較低的箭矢。

description.en: Shoots nearby mobs when you roll, costing one arrow per roll. Projectiles deal 40% of a charged shot's damage.
description.zh-Hant: 翻滾時會向附近怪物射箭，每次消耗 1 支箭；投射物造成蓄力射擊傷害的 40%。

description.en: When you attack with a charged shot, artifact cooldowns are decreased.
description.zh-Hant: 使用蓄力射擊攻擊時會縮短神器冷卻時間。

description.en: When you use a health potion, you are given a quiver of Poison Arrows.
description.zh-Hant: 使用生命藥水後會獲得一袋毒箭。

description.en: Every few shots has a timed charge that explodes one second after impact, dealing 100% damage to nearby mobs.
description.zh-Hant: 每隔數次射擊會射出定時箭矢；命中後 1 秒爆炸，對附近怪物造成 100% 傷害。

description.en: The fired shot grows in the air, dealing extra damage to distant targets.
description.zh-Hant: 射出的箭矢會在空中變大，對較遠目標造成額外傷害。

description.en: Chance to immediately replenish an arrow after shooting.
description.zh-Hant: 射擊後有機率立即補回一支箭。

description.en: Grants the chance to fire five arrows at once.
description.zh-Hant: 有機率一次射出五支箭。

description.en: Fired arrows sometimes gain the piercing effect, which allows them to fly through multiple mobs.
description.zh-Hant: 箭矢有時會獲得穿透效果，穿過多個怪物。

description.en: Power boosts arrow damage.
description.zh-Hant: 提高箭矢傷害。

description.en: Boosts arrow pushback.
description.zh-Hant: 提高箭矢擊退效果。

description.en: Increases your attack speed.
description.zh-Hant: 提高攻擊速度。

description.en: Small chance for arrows to ricochet off mobs.
description.zh-Hant: 箭矢有小機率從怪物身上彈射。

description.en: When you perform a roll, your next ranged attack within the timing window will automatically be fully charged.
description.zh-Hant: 翻滾後的時限內，下一次遠程攻擊會自動蓄滿。

description.en: Charged shots deal more damage and have more pushback.
description.zh-Hant: 蓄力射擊會造成更多傷害並提高擊退效果。

description.en: Hitting an enemy has a chance to send it into a rage, making it hostile towards everyone.
description.zh-Hant: 命中敵人時有機率使其狂暴，轉而攻擊所有人。

description.en: Has a chance to fire five arrows in all directions on impact.
description.zh-Hant: 有機率在命中時向四面八方射出五支箭。

description.en: After rolling, your next attack will cause the target to levitate briefly.
description.zh-Hant: 翻滾後，下一次攻擊會使目標短暫漂浮。

description.en: Continue to hold the ranged attack button to double, triple, or quadruple charge a bow, increasing its damage each time.
description.zh-Hant: 持續按住遠程攻擊可讓弓蓄力至雙倍、三倍或四倍，並逐步提高傷害。

description.en: Beams of lightning connect the last few charged arrows fired, which deal lightning damage to enemies who touch a beam.
description.zh-Hant: 最近射出的數支蓄力箭會以閃電束相連，接觸電束的敵人會受到閃電傷害。

description.en: Steals a small amount of a mob's movement speed and gives it to you for four seconds.
description.zh-Hant: 竊取怪物少量移動速度，並轉移給你 4 秒。

description.en: Reduces the cooldown time between your rolls.
description.zh-Hant: 縮短翻滾之間的冷卻時間。

description.en: Increases the maximum number of souls that can be carried.
description.zh-Hant: 提高可攜帶的靈魂上限。

description.en: Your pets deal more damage.
description.zh-Hant: 提高寵物造成的傷害。

description.en: Using a healing potion causes an explosion at your pets' locations, dealing damage to mobs around them.
description.zh-Hant: 使用治療藥水會在寵物所在位置引發爆炸，傷害附近怪物。

description.en: Using your health potion boosts your pets' attack and movement speed for 10 seconds.
description.zh-Hant: 使用生命藥水會提高寵物的攻擊與移動速度，持續 10 秒。

description.en: Every 0.5 seconds damages all nearby enemies.
description.zh-Hant: 每 0.5 秒傷害附近所有敵人。

description.en: Reduces the cooldown time between uses of your artifacts.
description.zh-Hant: 縮短神器之間的使用冷卻時間。

description.en: While you are at full HP, you deal increased ranged and melee damage.
description.zh-Hant: 生命值全滿時，提高遠程與近戰傷害。

description.en: Grants a small chance to deflect incoming projectiles.
description.zh-Hant: 有小機率偏轉來襲投射物。

description.en: Rolling zaps two nearby enemies with lightning bolts, dealing damage.
description.zh-Hant: 翻滾時以閃電擊中附近兩名敵人並造成傷害。

description.en: For every one hundred blocks explored on the map, you regain a small amount of health.
description.zh-Hant: 每探索地圖上的 100 個方塊，就恢復少量生命值。

description.en: Rolling creates a trail of fire behind you, which deals damage to mobs for four seconds.
description.zh-Hant: 翻滾時會在身後留下火焰軌跡，持續傷害怪物 4 秒。

description.en: Whenever you use a healing potion, you also create random food items.
description.zh-Hant: 使用治療藥水時也會生成隨機食物。

description.en: While you are at less than half health, your melee and ranged attack speeds are increased.
description.zh-Hant: 生命值低於一半時，提高近戰與遠程攻擊速度。

description.en: When activating any artifact, you regain a small amount of health.
description.zh-Hant: 啟動任何神器時恢復少量生命值。

description.en: Each time you respawn, your maximum health increases. Health goes back to normal after each mission.
description.zh-Hant: 每次重生時提高最大生命值；每場任務結束後恢復原狀。

description.en: Increases your luck, which boosts the chance that rare drops become unique.
description.zh-Hant: 提高幸運值，增加稀有掉落物成為獨特物品的機率。

sources.label: Minecraft Wiki · Luck of the Sea

description.en: Chance to spawn emeralds with every block explored.
description.zh-Hant: 探索每個方塊時都有機率生成綠寶石。

description.en: Whenever you use a healing potion, you take -90% damage for a short duration.
description.zh-Hant: 使用治療藥水時，短時間內受到的傷害降低 90%。

description.en: Your health is decreased by 40%, but your melee damage is increased.
description.zh-Hant: 生命值降低 40%，但近戰傷害提高。

description.en: Being hit by damage-inflicting projectiles will occasionally craft a small quiver of arrows.
description.zh-Hant: 受到造成傷害的投射物擊中時，有機率生成一小袋箭矢。

description.en: Increases movement speed for one second after taking damage.
description.zh-Hant: 受到傷害後提高移動速度 1 秒。

description.en: Leaving Shadow Form triggers a powerful blast that damages nearby mobs.
description.zh-Hant: 離開暗影形態時會引發強力爆炸，傷害附近怪物。

description.en: Mobs defeated while in Shadow Form grant extra souls
description.zh-Hant: 在暗影形態下擊敗怪物可獲得額外靈魂。

description.en: Fires a snowball at a nearby enemy every few seconds, briefly stunning it.
description.zh-Hant: 每隔數秒向附近敵人發射雪球，使其短暫暈眩。

description.en: When you gather a soul, you gain a 5% stacking movement speed boost for a short time.
description.zh-Hant: 收集靈魂時獲得可疊加的 5% 移動速度加成，持續一小段時間。

description.en: When activating any artifact, you gain +20% movement speed for a short time.
description.zh-Hant: 啟動任何神器時，短時間內提高 20% 移動速度。

description.en: Whenever you use a healing potion, you sometimes create random consumables.
description.zh-Hant: 使用治療藥水時，有時也會生成隨機消耗品。

description.en: Rolling makes you move faster for three seconds.
description.zh-Hant: 翻滾後移動速度提高 3 秒。

description.en: Whenever you take damage, you deal damage back to the attacker.
description.zh-Hant: 受到傷害時，會對攻擊者造成傷害。

description.en: Chance to summon a bee when you roll, with up to 3 bees joining your side.
description.zh-Hant: 翻滾時有機率召喚蜜蜂，最多可有 3 隻加入你的一方。

description.en: Emits a blast every two seconds that reduces the movement and attack speed of nearby enemies for one second.
description.zh-Hant: 每 2 秒釋放一次爆發，使附近敵人的移動與攻擊速度降低 1 秒。

description.en: The first amount of emeralds collected are stored and then spent to save the player from death.
description.zh-Hant: 收集到的第一批綠寶石會被存起來，並在你瀕死時消耗以救你一命。

description.en: When your health drops below 25%, all your artifacts are used (ignoring cooldown periods).
description.zh-Hant: 生命值低於 25% 時，所有神器會無視冷卻時間自動使用。

description.en: The fire damage you deal is increased.
description.zh-Hant: 提高你造成的火焰傷害。

description.en: A blast occurs every three seconds that pulls nearby enemies towards you.
description.zh-Hant: 每 3 秒產生一次爆發，將附近敵人拉向你。

description.en: The lightning damage you deal is increased.
description.zh-Hant: 提高你造成的閃電傷害。

description.en: Grants extra rolls.
description.zh-Hant: 增加可使用的翻滾次數。

description.en: The poison damage you deal is increased.
description.zh-Hant: 提高你造成的毒素傷害。

description.en: Reduces damage taken.
description.zh-Hant: 降低受到的傷害。

description.en: Increases the amount of soul damage you deal.
description.zh-Hant: 提高你造成的靈魂傷害。

description.en: Inflicts Poison
description.zh-Hant: 使敵人中毒。

description.en: 100% increased speed temporarily after defeating a mob.
description.zh-Hant: 擊敗怪物後，短暫提高 100% 移動速度。

description.en: Excess damage hits nearby mobs.
description.zh-Hant: 超出目標所需的傷害會波及附近怪物。

description.en: Hits Multiple targets when charged
description.zh-Hant: 蓄力箭會在怪物之間彈射，最多命中三次。

description.en: First shot does not break Shadow Form.
description.zh-Hant: 第一發射擊不會解除暗影形態。

description.en: Chance of Shadow Form on kills
description.zh-Hant: 擊殺時有機率進入暗影形態。

description.en: Fully charged arrows become gale arrows; hitting an enemy with one forms a helix of wind that pulls the enemy closer to the player.
description.zh-Hant: 完全蓄力的箭會變成疾風箭；命中敵人後形成風旋，將敵人拉近。

description.en: Brief damage immunity when collects an emerald
description.zh-Hant: 拾取綠寶石時短暫免疫傷害。

description.en: Environmental damage resistance.
description.zh-Hant: 降低環境造成的傷害。

description.en: When surrounded by 4 or more enemies, take 50% less damage.
description.zh-Hant: 周圍有 4 隻或更多敵人時，受到的傷害降低 50%。

description.en: Every once in awhile, enemies will be knocked back after a melee attack.
description.zh-Hant: 近戰攻擊偶爾會將敵人擊退。

description.en: Any melee weapon enchanted with Withering grants the user the ability to inflict Wither upon physical contact.
description.zh-Hant: 使武器使用者能透過實體接觸對目標施加凋零效果。

value.zh-Hant: 英雄無法取得；此效果會在怪物身上生效。

description.en: Arrows passing through allies gives them a small amount of damage boost.
description.zh-Hant: 箭矢穿過盟友時會給予少量傷害加成。

description.en: Damage resistance increases with the number of nearby enemies.
description.zh-Hant: 附近敵人越多，傷害抗性越高。

description.zh-Hant: Wiki 未提供遊戲內說明。

description.zh-Hant: 你受到傷害時會治療盟友。

description.en: If you avoid taking damage for 10 seconds, you will start regenerating health.
description.zh-Hant: 若 10 秒內未受到傷害，就會開始恢復生命。

value.zh-Hant: 英雄無法取得；此效果會在怪物身上生效。

description.en: Adds damage resistance to you and nearby allies.
description.zh-Hant: 為你和附近盟友增加傷害抗性。

description.en: Makes the mob invisible and invincible unless it is attacking or casting.
description.zh-Hant: 使怪物隱形並免於被攻擊，直到牠攻擊或施法。

value.en: Only used by seasonal event mobs; unavailable to heroes.
value.zh-Hant: 只用於季節活動怪物，英雄無法取得。

description.en: Allows the Heart of Ender to leave a trail of void-like substance when it walks.
description.zh-Hant: 使心之末影在行走時留下虛空狀物質的軌跡。

value.en: Unavailable to heroes; the effect is active on mobs.
value.zh-Hant: 英雄無法取得；此效果會在怪物身上生效。

description.en: Makes a mob larger; its damage and health remain unchanged.
description.zh-Hant: 使怪物體型變大，但不提高其傷害或生命值。

value.en: Unavailable to heroes; the effect is active on mobs.
value.zh-Hant: 英雄無法取得；此效果會在怪物身上生效。

description.en: Allows the aura bearer to revive nearby mobs.
description.zh-Hant: 光環攜帶者能復活附近死亡的怪物。

value.en: Unavailable to heroes; the effect is active on mobs.
value.zh-Hant: 英雄無法取得；此效果會在怪物身上生效。

description.en: Doubles the damage dealt by the mob to the hero.
description.zh-Hant: 使怪物對英雄造成的傷害加倍。

value.en: Unavailable to heroes; the effect is active on mobs.
value.zh-Hant: 英雄無法取得；此效果會在怪物身上生效。

description.en: Grants mobs fast and quick attacks.
description.zh-Hant: 使怪物能以更快的速度攻擊。

value.en: Unavailable to heroes; the effect is active on mobs.
value.zh-Hant: 英雄無法取得；此效果會在怪物身上生效。

description.en: Grants the mob increased speed, similar to Swiftness.
description.zh-Hant: 提高怪物的移動速度。

value.zh-Hant: 英雄無法取得；此效果會在怪物身上生效。
